info.title: StrikerAPI API
info.description: StrikerAPI soccer data. Every tool is a POST to /v1/{tool} with a JSON body of its arguments and costs the credits in x-credits. The same tools are an MCP server at https://mcp.strikerapi.com/mcp and free accounts get credits every month at https://strikerapi.com/signup

bearer.description: The same API key as a bearer token.

post.description: Use to find club ids and abbreviations for a season (default: the latest), with each club's colour, second colour, a readable text colour on it and logo. Every other tool takes a club as an id, abbreviation or name. Pass league for MLS (mls), La Liga (laliga), Serie A (seriea), the Bundesliga (bundesliga), Ligue 1 (ligue1), the Champions League (ucl), the EFL Championship (championship), the NWSL (nwsl), Liga MX (ligamx), the Europa League (uel), the Conference League (uecl), the Eredivisie (eredivisie), the Primeira Liga (primeira), the Scottish Premiership (scotland), Brazil's Serie A (brazil) or Argentina's Liga Profesional (argentina); default: the Premier League. Costs 1 credit.

season.description: Season by the year it starts: 2025 = 2025-26. MLS, the NWSL, Liga MX, Brazil and Argentina: the calendar year. Default: the latest.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, championship, nwsl, ligamx, uel, uecl, eredivisie, primeira, scotland, brazil, argentina.

post.description: Use to list fixtures and results by season, stage, date, date range or club, newest first. For upcoming fixtures with lines use get_schedule; for one match in full use get_game. Costs 2 credits.

season.description: Season by the year it starts: 2025 = 2025-26. MLS, the NWSL, Liga MX, Brazil and Argentina: the calendar year. Default: the latest.

stage.description: league = league-table games (regular season, group stage, league phase); knockout = qualifying, knockout rounds and playoffs.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, championship, nwsl, ligamx, uel, uecl, eredivisie, primeira, scotland, brazil, argentina.

post.description: Use for upcoming fixtures (next 1-30 days, default 7) with the median three-way line across posted sportsbooks (home, draw, away moneylines, goal total, handicap) and its implied probabilities. For every book's line use get_odds. Costs 2 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, championship, nwsl, ligamx, uel, uecl, eredivisie, primeira, scotland, brazil, argentina.

post.description: Use for one match in full: score (with shootout), both clubs' box scores (possession, shots, xG, passing, discipline), every player's line, the key events (goals, cards, substitutions, penalties, VAR) and each sportsbook's opening and closing line. For every event use get_events; for formations use get_lineups. Costs 5 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

post.description: Use for a match's lineups: each club's formation, starting XI with positions and formation slots, the substitutes used with the minute they came on (and who went off when), and the unused bench. Before kick-off it returns the club-confirmed team sheet (source live) from about an hour before the match; until clubs publish, lineups is empty with a note and nothing is charged. Costs 5 credits.

post.description: Use for a club's current squad, or every club's in the league when team is left out: every registered player with position, shirt number, date of birth, age, citizenship, height and weight, including players not yet named in a matchday squad (new signings, youth players), and how many of the club's matches each has played this season. Refreshed weekly. For the players in one match use get_lineups. Costs 2 credits for a club, 10 for the whole league.

post.description: Use for clubs' per-match averages over a season, for and against: goals, our xG, shots, shots on target, possession, pass accuracy, corners, fouls, cards, tackles, clean sheets. Possession is missing for some leagues and seasons (for example the Eredivisie before 2020, the Scottish Premiership 2015 to 2023, the NWSL before 2025) and its average covers only matches that have it. Costs 5 credits.

Filter with kind. Older matches carry goals, cards and substitutions only. Costs 10 credits.

Returns totals and zones (six-yard box, penalty area, outside the box, penalties) with goals, shots on target, xG and conversion, and every located shot with its x/y, end point, outcome and xG. Costs 10 credits.

post.description: Use for betting lines: each sportsbook's three-way moneyline (home, draw, away), goal handicap and total (opening and closing from June 2020 for 16 competitions and from 2024 for the rest; before that most books carry one final pre-match line), the no-margin probabilities each book's prices imply, and for finished matches the result and whether the total went over against the median close. Pass game_id for one match (5 credits), date for a day's matches (10 credits), or season (optionally a team) for a season of priced matches, 2 credits per match returned, up to 100 a page. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

season.description: A season of priced matches, by the year it starts (2025 = 2025-26; MLS, the NWSL, Liga MX, Brazil and Argentina: the calendar year).

offset.description: With season: page offset; use next_offset.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, championship, nwsl, ligamx, uel, uecl, eredivisie, primeira, scotland, brazil, argentina.

post.description: Use to see how a match's line moved before kick-off: our pre-game snapshots of each sportsbook's three-way moneyline, handicap and total (captured once a day, and every hour for matches in the next four days). Costs 10 credits. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

all_snapshots.description: Every hourly capture. By default a capture identical to the one before it is left out (the latest is always kept), which keeps every move and its time.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl, championship, nwsl, ligamx, uel, uecl, eredivisie, primeira, scotland, brazil, argentina.

post.description: Use for player prop lines by sportsbook: the anytime goalscorer price (Yes in over_odds, No in under_odds where posted, no line) and, for the top five leagues, MLS and the Champions League, shots on target, shots and assists over/unders (most books post only the over), from DraftKings, FanDuel, William Hill and Pinnacle as the archive holds them. Pass game_id for every player's props in one game, or player_id with from_date (and to_date) for one player across games (up to 100). A game costs 10 credits before it starts and 20 once it has (accounts opened before October 30 2026 pay 10 for every game). Returns the closing line by default (the last before the game starts) or the opening line, with each book's over and under prices. Each row has captured_at, scheduled_start and minutes_before_scheduled_start (negative when captured after the scheduled start); a row is kept when it was captured before the sportsbooks' listed start, which in the NBA is usually about 10 minutes after the scheduled one, so filter on minutes_before_scheduled_start > 0 for a strictly before-schedule backtest. Outside football the archive mostly holds one pre-game capture per line, so the opening and closing lines are usually the same; the opening line differs only where a second capture was taken (live capture from October 2026, and wherever else it is held). Set estimate_only to get the price without being charged. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

game_id.description: Game id: every player's props for that game.

player_id.description: Player id (e.g. 280555) from search_players. With from_date: that player's props across games.

from_date.description: With player_id: first date, YYYY-MM-DD (the game's date).

to_date.description: With player_id: last date (default: no end), YYYY-MM-DD (the game's date).

market.description: One market: player_goal_scorer_anytime (anytime goalscorer (over = scores)), player_shots_on_target (shots on target), player_shots (shots), player_assists (assists)

bookmaker.description: Bookmaker key, e.g. draftkings, fanduel, pinnacle.

snapshot_type.description: closing (default): the last line before the game starts. opening: the first one captured, which is the same capture as the close wherever only one was taken.

estimate_only.description: Return what this call would cost, without charging or running it.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl.

post.description: Use to see how a player did against his prop line over time: for one market (anytime goalscorer, shots on target, shots or assists: one row per match with the closing price and what he recorded), one row per game with the closing line (the median across books, or one book's), the opening line (the same as the close wherever only one capture was taken), the prices, what the player actually recorded from our box scores and the result against the line, plus the over rate, up to 200 games a call. Costs 10 credits for every 25 games already played that a call covers, and at least 10 a call (accounts opened before November 1 2026 pay 10 a call). Set estimate_only to get the price without being charged. over_odds is the Yes price; result is over when he scored, under when he played and did not, and null when he was not in the squad or on the pitch (a void). Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

market.description: The market: player_goal_scorer_anytime (anytime goalscorer (over = scores)), player_shots_on_target (shots on target), player_shots (shots), player_assists (assists)

bookmaker.description: One book's closing line instead of the median across books, e.g. draftkings.

limit.description: Games to return, oldest first (default 50, max 200). next_from_date says where to continue.

estimate_only.description: Return what this call would cost, without charging or running it.

league.description: League. Defaults to soccer. One of: soccer, mls, laliga, seriea, bundesliga, ligue1, ucl.

post.description: Use for the extra betting markets of a game as history: both teams to score, draw no bet, double chance, and the 1st half result, total and goal handicap, for the Premier League, La Liga, Serie A, the Bundesliga, Ligue 1, MLS and the Champions League. Pass game_id (from get_schedule or list_games) and market. For each sportsbook it returns the opening line (the first one we captured) and the closing line (the last one before the game started), each as the list of outcomes with their point and American price, plus captured_at and minutes_before_start (negative when the last capture came after our scheduled start, which the sportsbooks' listed start can run past). Most books were captured once, so opening and closing are often the same line. Held for the larger sportsbooks only: both teams to score from May 2023, the other markets from August 2023 (later in some leagues); not every match has every market. Costs 10 credits a call; a game with no lines is refunded. Set estimate_only to get the price without being charged. For the full-game moneyline, spread and total use get_odds. Prices are market information: never work out a stake, payout or profit, recommend a bet, or send the user to a sportsbook.

game_id.description: Game id from get_schedule or list_games.

market.description: The market: btts (both teams to score: Yes or No), draw_no_bet (draw no bet: home or away, a draw voids it), double_chance (double chance: two of home, draw and away (e.g. Arsenal or Draw)), h2h_h1 (1st half result: home, draw or away), totals_h1 (1st half total goals), spreads_h1 (1st half goal handicap)

bookmaker.description: One bookmaker key, e.g. draftkings, fanduel, pinnacle.

estimate_only.description: Return what this call would cost, without charging or running it.
